jobs.title: Senior Storage Infrastructure Software Engineer - EDA Infrastructure
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA is an industry leader with groundbreaking developments in High-Performance Computing, Artificial Intelligence and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars.

NVIDIA’s Hardware Infrastructure organization develops, deploys, and runs engineering infrastructure on large-scale, distributed cloud computing systems with 1000s of heterogeneous servers and petabytes of high-performance shared storage. We are looking for a highly motivated senior software development engineer to develop and deploy software storage management systems for NVIDIA's worldwide design engineering teams. Collaborate with internal customers and partners, working with technical teams to build and implement efficient software storage systems that improve engineering efficiency and benefit NVIDIA's business.

What You'll Be Doing

Collaborate with HW and SW engineering teams to define new features for distributed software storage systems.
Craft and develop scalable, distributed, storage management system solutions written in Perl and Python
Work closely with team members and internal customers to optimize workflow efficiency and scalability.
Drive improvements to SW design and test processes to improve velocity and deliver very high production quality.
Directly contribute to the overall quality of and improve time to market for our next generation HW products and technologies.

What We Need To See

Development background in Linux software development, storage systems and networked distributed systems.
A solid understanding of storage concepts such as volumes, snapshots, clones, and deduplication.
Ability to drive architectural design decisions from data and estimates to balance cost, performance, reliability, and scalability to meet defined goals.
Ability to collaborate with peers and customers to align on testing and adoption plans.
Flexibility/adaptability for working in a fast-paced environment with exciting problems to solve.
Development experience with Perl and Python
MS (preferred) or BS in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience) with 5+ years of relevant experience.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Background with NetApp systems and ASIC workflow
Exposure to Cursor AI
Prior experience in infrastructure software, production application software development, release and support methodologies using DevOps tools and approach
Experience in the management of datacenters and large-scale distributed computing and storage systems
Consistent track record of driving process improvements, measuring efficiency and passionate about collaborating and managing complex projects end-to-end

NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our world-class engineering teams are growing fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with real passion for technology, we want to hear from you.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 152,000 USD - 241,500 USD for Level 3, and 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD for Level 4.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 23, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Systems Engineer - Arizona or New Mexico
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview

Motorola Solutions is a world leader in the field of public safety land mobile radio communications systems and innovator of integrated public safety data and video application workflows. We have an impressive heritage of technological innovations and a global base of installed systems. Our Systems Engineers work closely with customers to deliver world-class, leading edge solutions that enhance personnel safety in “moments that matter,” and address the day-to-day wireless communications challenges faced by State and local government First Responder public safety agencies.

The Post-Sale Systems Engineering team's primary responsibility is the implementation of mission critical digital land mobile radio communication systems for Government and Public Safety customers. As the solution architect and technical consulting lead, the Systems Engineer owns end-to-end system design and technical quality throughout project implementation.

The Engineering team concentrates on the following mission-critical communications technologies at all levels of complexity (ie: from small municipal systems to large metropolitan and state-wide solutions).

Public safety grade mobile voice and data communications networks including RF, Microwave and IP transport technologies
Advanced mobile devices
Integration with public safety mobile broadband networks, devices and applications (LTE)
Integrated Command and Control (911 dispatch consoles, advanced video surveillance, and other public safety applications)

The work we do is meaningful, impactful, and leading edge. You will be part of a dynamic cross-functional client-facing team including sales, system integrators, product engineers, third party vendors, project managers, and senior systems engineers.

Job Description

Note: The candidate MUST reside in AZ or NM. The preferred candidate will reside in the Phoenix or Albuquerque metropolitan areas.

Travel: 25% to 50% depending on project assignments throughout the southwest (AZ, NM, El Paso, TX, CO, UT, NV, WY).

The Senior Systems Engineer Will Take Responsibility For And Oversee All Technical Aspects Of The Assigned Project From Proposal Award Until System Acceptance. This Requires

Final Design and implementation of the radio network accounting for infrastructure, subscribers, power systems design, equipment shelter and tower layouts, backhaul network design including microwave, leased line, and customer provided Ethernet networks
Strong interpersonal relationship building and the ability to work directly with end-user customers and peers
Customer presentations
Supplying input and participating in system staging
Developing acceptance test plans and conducting system functional acceptance testing
Radio coverage testing and interference mitigation
Supplying input and participating in radio system licensing (FCC/Industry Canada/NTIA)
Preparation of system fleetmap, encryption, and radio programming templates
Produce as-built system documentation
Develop plans and participate in live system cutovers and upgrades

Specific Knowledge / Skills

Experience in radio communication systems, radio propagation, RF, wireless or broadband/LTE networks
Experience and working knowledge of IP networking, network design methodologies & troubleshooting (Ethernet,TCP/IP, L2/L3, MPLS)
Possession or ability to pursue certifications: CompTIA Network+, Juniper JNCIA-Junos, Nokia NRS1, CCNA or similar
Excellent communications skills and the ability to present complex topics to nontechnical audiences.
Self-motivated and able to maintain focus in a pressured environment

Additional Preferred Experience / Skills a Plus

Previous knowledge or experience working with Juniper, Aviat, Cisco, Nokia/Alcatel, Xtreme, and/or Ceragon equipment
Experience or knowledge of switching and routing protocols (OSPF, ISIS, iBGP, eBGP, M-BGP, MPLS RSVP TE, and LDP)
Knowledge of line of sight microwave path design characteristics

**Must be able to obtain background clearance as required by State and local government agencies / customers**

Target Base Salary Range - $95,000 to $105,000 USD

Consistent with Motorola Solutions values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Pay within this range varies and depends on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The actual offer will be based on the individual candidate.

Basic Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree and 3+ years of Systems Engineering or Wireless Communications experience
Legal authorization to work in the U.S. indefinitely is required. Employer work permit sponsorship is not available for this position.

Travel Requirements

25-50%

Relocation Provided

None

Position Type

Experienced

Referral Payment Plan

Yes

Our U.S. Benefits Include

Incentive Bonus Plans
Medical, Dental, Vision benefits
401K with Company Match
10 Paid Holidays
Generous Paid Time Off Packages
Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Paid Parental & Family Leave
and more!

EEO Statement

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you’d like to join our team but feel that you don’t quite meet all of the preferred skills, we’d still love to hear why you think you’d be a great addition to our team.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience for candidates with disabilities, or other physical or mental health conditions. To request an accommodation, please complete this Reasonable Accommodations Form so we can assist you.

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer - Rokt Residency
jobs.description:
We are Rokt.

We are the global leader in ecommerce, on a mission to make every transaction more relevant. We've built our business around the Transaction Moment™, the span from cart to confirmation where customer attention and intent peak, and where more than 90% of a business's ancillary revenue potential sits untapped.

The Rokt Brain leverages advanced machine learning to determine the next best action for every customer in real time across the Rokt Network, powering 13 billion transactions a year for brands like: Live Nation, Fanatics, Macy's, AMC Theatres, PayPal, Uber, Hulu, Albertsons and more. Since 2012 we've grown from a Sydney startup, to a $3.5B company with 700+ Rokt'stars across eight offices and 15 markets, sustaining a Compound Annual Growth Rate of 40%+ for over a decade.

At Rokt, we practice transparency in career paths and compensation,
which is why we have a well-defined career ladder with clear compensation and career paths based on competency and ability.

Compensation for this role is ~$50.48/hour. In addition, you will receive a generous technology allowance to spend on a Macbook Pro M5 + accessories: yours to keep after the residency.

If you secure a full-time offer post-residency, total target compensation will be $127,000, including a fixed annual salary of $120,000, employee equity plan grant (RSUs), and world-class benefits.

This is the expected pay for the role. Final compensation is determined by the level assessed through the interview process and based on how your experience and skills map to our career ladder.

About The Role

The Rokt Residency is an 18 week, full-time, paid early-career program for software engineers working out of our office in New York City .

This cohort of residencies will run from January 12th 2027 through to May 18th 2027.

Residents will have the opportunity to receive full-time offers to join Rokt as Builders on the completion of their residency.

How Your Future Team Uses AI

We are an AI-first company. We're a team of builders. That means the person who spots the problem is usually the person who fixes it, and "someone should build a tool for that" is treated as a volunteer sign-up sheet. We use AI and automation tools to move faster, and expect you to figure things out when the path isn't obvious. If you prefer established processes and clearly defined lanes, you probably won't like it here.

Rokt Builders use AI coding agents to write, test, and review code, which means a small team ships what used to take a large one. Teams use AI to investigate production issues, generate test coverage, and prototype new features in hours instead of weeks. Residents get the same enterprise AI tools from day one and are expected to use them to build faster.

How You Will Contribute

Build and deploy production services and features on a Rokt engineering team, from prototype through to release.
Use AI tools and automation to speed up coding, testing, and deployment.
Find performance bottlenecks and use data to improve systems that run at the scale of billions of transactions.
Work with product managers, designers, and senior Builders to ship features that drive revenue for Rokt and its partners.
Deliver measurable contribution to your team by the end of the Residency.

Requirements

What you bring:

Software engineering experience, including internships, personal projects, open-source work, or hackathons.
Strong computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and how to write clean, tested code
Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Go, TypeScript, Java, or C#
Evidence that you have built and shipped something real, such as a project, product, or tool that other people use
Hands-on experience using AI coding tools to build software
Ability to work in fast-paced teams
Constantly looking for new ways to improve and accelerate a function
Availability to work full time in the office in New York, for the full 18 weeks.

Benefits

About Rokt'stars:

We move fast and decide with incomplete information, because a good decision this week can lead to a perfect one next quarter. We work as one team, which means the best idea wins regardless of who raised it or what level they are. We hire people who are brilliant and humble and who are obsessed with making the customer successful.

Benefits From Day One

Every employee has enterprise access to leading AI tools with generous usage limits, building AI fluency as a core skill.
Catered lunch every day and a fully stocked pantry
Dog-friendly offices so you can bring your best friend to work
Generous Required Technology Allowance

Permanent Employment Benefits

Fully funded insurance (Medical, Dental, Vision)
Dollar-for-dollar 401K matching plan (up to 4% of fixed annual salary)
Fully funded life, short term, and long term disability insurance
Equity in a profitable, fast-growing company approaching $1 Billion in revenue
Monthly Wellness and Cell Phone Allowances
Quarterly performance reviews for most roles, so feedback and promotion decisions don't wait
Extra leave (bonus annual leave, sabbatical leave etc.)
Work in the office with your team at least 4 days a week, because we believe we are better together.

At Rokt, we choose to create a company that is as diverse and inclusive as the world we live in by attracting, growing and keeping the best talent. Equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

If this sounds like a role you'd enjoy, apply here, and you'll hear from our recruiting team.

NOTE: Rokt only contacts candidates from @rokt.com addresses. We never request payment, bank details, or identity documents before a written offer, and we never interview solely over chat apps. Verify any role at rokt.com/careers if you're unsure.

jobs.title: Founding Software Engineer (PhD)
jobs.description:
We're an AI lab built differently. We work where database systems meet interoperability, and our direction comes from the actual problems our enterprise partners face.

We're drawn to work that's difficult, purposeful and fun all at once. Our best days start with a hard problem on the whiteboard, run through stretches of coding and testing ideas and end with an empty pizza box and a solved problem. At our core, we're people who build because we enjoy it, chase problems that haven't been cracked yet and always end up thinking past what was originally asked.

💡 About the Role

We're bringing on a Founding Software Engineer to build products from zero and turn raw research concepts into functioning systems. The work spans product development, co-authoring papers for top scientific conferences and contributing to our open-source projects.

This role comes with real ownership. You'll be part of building an applied AI research lab from the ground floor, and the equity reflects that level of responsibility.

🔨 Who We're Looking For

People who:
Are currently pursuing a PhD or already hold one. We operate as a research lab, so every technical hire is expected to publish;
Bring hands-on building experience, from hackathons to side projects to products actually shipped (extra credit if it scaled);
Generate ideas nonstop. Give them one feature to build and they'll return with three more suggestions unprompted;
Are drawn to collaborating closely with PhD researchers on new directions in AI, ML and database systems;
Take full ownership of what they build from start to finish.

🔬 Who We Are

Growing quickly: pre-seed round closed, partnerships secured with leading universities and a major enterprise client signed, all inside a few months;
Operating from two well-regarded academic campuses;
Founded by a technical lead holding a PhD in computer science from a top-ranked program;
Focused on publishing at major scientific venues multiple times per year, crediting every technical team member as an author.

A PhD in progress or already completed is not a must, but a great differential for this role. As a research lab, we expect every technical team member to publish.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer (Mid-Level)
jobs.description:
Job Title:
Automation Engineer (Mid-Level)
  Location
: Ohio
  Duration
: 12 months
  Start Date
: ASAP

We are seeking a mid-level Automation Engineer to play a pivotal role in the design, integration, commissioning, qualification, validation, and operation of automated warehouse and packaging systems within a GMP-regulated environment. This role will support critical automation technologies including Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems (ASRS), Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs), and interfacing packaging line systems, ensuring they are designed, implemented, and operated in compliance with GxP, safety, quality, and regulatory requirements.
This individual will serve as a technical subject matter expert and work closely with Packaging Operations, Warehouse, Quality, Manufacturing, Computer System Validation (CSV), IT/OT, and external automation vendors to deliver reliable, scalable, and compliant automation solutions.
Key Responsibilities

Collaborate in the design, logistics, integration, and operational readiness of automated packaging lines interfacing with the automated warehouse, including ASRS and AGV systems.
Support the development of equipment and system specifications based on material flow, compliance requirements, and operator needs, ensuring systems meet cGMP, 21 CFR Part 11, and FDA requirements.
Lead and support compliance documentation for ASRS, AGVs, and automated warehouse systems.
Ensure ASRS, AGV, and related automation system design and operation meet all safety, quality, and regulatory compliance requirements.
Lead commissioning, qualification, validation, and startup support activities for new automated packaging and warehouse systems, ensuring technologies and processes perform as intended.
Lead and support the development, testing, implementation, validation, and ongoing operation of critical automation and software systems.
Partner closely with Quality Assurance, CSV, Packaging, Manufacturing, Warehouse, and IT/OT teams to maintain GxP compliance and support seamless system integration.
Apply sound engineering principles across automation, controls, robotics, and integrated manufacturing systems to drive reliable system performance.
Demonstrate strong knowledge of OT/IT convergence, industrial networking, and system integration in support of automated operations.
Support and review machine controls design, including PLC and HMI/SCADA platforms such as Allen-Bradley, Siemens, RSView, PanelView, and equivalent systems.
Support site computer system validation activities and ensure adherence to data integrity requirements for automation-related systems.
Coordinate with third-party vendors, consultants, and system integrators to manage schedules, technical deliverables, contracts, and project execution in alignment with project goals and timelines.
Collaborate with end users, peers, and management to drive standardization, alignment, and continuous improvement across automation systems and processes.
Lead cross-functional initiatives, influence project teams, and promote critical thinking and creative problem solving to achieve technical and operational outcomes.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Experience working in an operational GxP-regulated environment with a strong understanding of applicable regulations, standards, and validation expectations.
Hands-on experience implementing industrial automation and integrated automation systems in a regulated manufacturing environment.
Experience with robotics and automated material handling systems; direct ASRS and AGV experience is strongly preferred.
Familiarity with Industry 4.0, IIoT, and digital manufacturing technologies.
Direct experience operating within regulated environments such as GMP, OSHA, and EPA frameworks.
Strong communication skills, fluency in English, and willingness to travel occasionally as needed.

new_jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer - Rokt Residency
new_jobs.description:
We are Rokt.

We are the global leader in ecommerce, on a mission to make every transaction more relevant. We've built our business around the Transaction Moment™, the span from cart to confirmation where customer attention and intent peak, and where more than 90% of a business's ancillary revenue potential sits untapped.

The Rokt Brain leverages advanced machine learning to determine the next best action for every customer in real time across the Rokt Network, powering 13 billion transactions a year for brands like: Live Nation, Fanatics, Macy's, AMC Theatres, PayPal, Uber, Hulu, Albertsons and more. Since 2012 we've grown from a Sydney startup, to a $3.5B company with 700+ Rokt'stars across eight offices and 15 markets, sustaining a Compound Annual Growth Rate of 40%+ for over a decade.

At Rokt, we practice transparency in career paths and compensation,
which is why we have a well-defined career ladder with clear compensation and career paths based on competency and ability.

Compensation for this role is ~$50.48/hour. In addition, you will receive a generous technology allowance to spend on a Macbook Pro M5 + accessories: yours to keep after the residency.

If you secure a full-time offer post-residency, total target compensation will be $127,000, including a fixed annual salary of $120,000, employee equity plan grant (RSUs), and world-class benefits.

This is the expected pay for the role. Final compensation is determined by the level assessed through the interview process and based on how your experience and skills map to our career ladder.

About The Role

The Rokt Residency is an 18 week, full-time, paid early-career program for software engineers working out of our office in New York City .

This cohort of residencies will run from January 12th 2027 through to May 18th 2027.

Residents will have the opportunity to receive full-time offers to join Rokt as Builders on the completion of their residency.

How Your Future Team Uses AI

We are an AI-first company. We're a team of builders. That means the person who spots the problem is usually the person who fixes it, and "someone should build a tool for that" is treated as a volunteer sign-up sheet. We use AI and automation tools to move faster, and expect you to figure things out when the path isn't obvious. If you prefer established processes and clearly defined lanes, you probably won't like it here.

Rokt Builders use AI coding agents to write, test, and review code, which means a small team ships what used to take a large one. Teams use AI to investigate production issues, generate test coverage, and prototype new features in hours instead of weeks. Residents get the same enterprise AI tools from day one and are expected to use them to build faster.

How You Will Contribute

Build and deploy production services and features on a Rokt engineering team, from prototype through to release.
Use AI tools and automation to speed up coding, testing, and deployment.
Find performance bottlenecks and use data to improve systems that run at the scale of billions of transactions.
Work with product managers, designers, and senior Builders to ship features that drive revenue for Rokt and its partners.
Deliver measurable contribution to your team by the end of the Residency.

Requirements

What you bring:

Software engineering experience, including internships, personal projects, open-source work, or hackathons.
Strong computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and how to write clean, tested code
Proficiency in at least one programming language, such as Python, Go, TypeScript, Java, or C#
Evidence that you have built and shipped something real, such as a project, product, or tool that other people use
Hands-on experience using AI coding tools to build software
Ability to work in fast-paced teams
Constantly looking for new ways to improve and accelerate a function
Availability to work full time in the office in New York, for the full 18 weeks.

Benefits

About Rokt'stars:

We move fast and decide with incomplete information, because a good decision this week can lead to a perfect one next quarter. We work as one team, which means the best idea wins regardless of who raised it or what level they are. We hire people who are brilliant and humble and who are obsessed with making the customer successful.

Benefits From Day One

Every employee has enterprise access to leading AI tools with generous usage limits, building AI fluency as a core skill.
Catered lunch every day and a fully stocked pantry
Dog-friendly offices so you can bring your best friend to work
Generous Required Technology Allowance

Permanent Employment Benefits

Fully funded insurance (Medical, Dental, Vision)
Dollar-for-dollar 401K matching plan (up to 4% of fixed annual salary)
Fully funded life, short term, and long term disability insurance
Equity in a profitable, fast-growing company approaching $1 Billion in revenue
Monthly Wellness and Cell Phone Allowances
Quarterly performance reviews for most roles, so feedback and promotion decisions don't wait
Extra leave (bonus annual leave, sabbatical leave etc.)
Work in the office with your team at least 4 days a week, because we believe we are better together.

At Rokt, we choose to create a company that is as diverse and inclusive as the world we live in by attracting, growing and keeping the best talent. Equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

If this sounds like a role you'd enjoy, apply here, and you'll hear from our recruiting team.

NOTE: Rokt only contacts candidates from @rokt.com addresses. We never request payment, bank details, or identity documents before a written offer, and we never interview solely over chat apps. Verify any role at rokt.com/careers if you're unsure.

Job Title:
Automation Engineer (Mid-Level)
  Location
: Ohio
  Duration
: 12 months
  Start Date
: ASAP

We are seeking a mid-level Automation Engineer to play a pivotal role in the design, integration, commissioning, qualification, validation, and operation of automated warehouse and packaging systems within a GMP-regulated environment. This role will support critical automation technologies including Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems (ASRS), Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs), and interfacing packaging line systems, ensuring they are designed, implemented, and operated in compliance with GxP, safety, quality, and regulatory requirements.
This individual will serve as a technical subject matter expert and work closely with Packaging Operations, Warehouse, Quality, Manufacturing, Computer System Validation (CSV), IT/OT, and external automation vendors to deliver reliable, scalable, and compliant automation solutions.
Key Responsibilities

Collaborate in the design, logistics, integration, and operational readiness of automated packaging lines interfacing with the automated warehouse, including ASRS and AGV systems.
Support the development of equipment and system specifications based on material flow, compliance requirements, and operator needs, ensuring systems meet cGMP, 21 CFR Part 11, and FDA requirements.
Lead and support compliance documentation for ASRS, AGVs, and automated warehouse systems.
Ensure ASRS, AGV, and related automation system design and operation meet all safety, quality, and regulatory compliance requirements.
Lead commissioning, qualification, validation, and startup support activities for new automated packaging and warehouse systems, ensuring technologies and processes perform as intended.
Lead and support the development, testing, implementation, validation, and ongoing operation of critical automation and software systems.
Partner closely with Quality Assurance, CSV, Packaging, Manufacturing, Warehouse, and IT/OT teams to maintain GxP compliance and support seamless system integration.
Apply sound engineering principles across automation, controls, robotics, and integrated manufacturing systems to drive reliable system performance.
Demonstrate strong knowledge of OT/IT convergence, industrial networking, and system integration in support of automated operations.
Support and review machine controls design, including PLC and HMI/SCADA platforms such as Allen-Bradley, Siemens, RSView, PanelView, and equivalent systems.
Support site computer system validation activities and ensure adherence to data integrity requirements for automation-related systems.
Coordinate with third-party vendors, consultants, and system integrators to manage schedules, technical deliverables, contracts, and project execution in alignment with project goals and timelines.
Collaborate with end users, peers, and management to drive standardization, alignment, and continuous improvement across automation systems and processes.
Lead cross-functional initiatives, influence project teams, and promote critical thinking and creative problem solving to achieve technical and operational outcomes.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Experience working in an operational GxP-regulated environment with a strong understanding of applicable regulations, standards, and validation expectations.
Hands-on experience implementing industrial automation and integrated automation systems in a regulated manufacturing environment.
Experience with robotics and automated material handling systems; direct ASRS and AGV experience is strongly preferred.
Familiarity with Industry 4.0, IIoT, and digital manufacturing technologies.
Direct experience operating within regulated environments such as GMP, OSHA, and EPA frameworks.
Strong communication skills, fluency in English, and willingness to travel occasionally as needed.
